exposure: Hypoglycemia during 100-g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: The study included 2079 live-born deliveries from a single medical center during 2018-2019, with available OGTT results and birth outcomes, excluding preterm deliveries (<34 weeks), multiple pregnancies, and major anomalies.
finding: Hypoglycemia detected during a 100-g oral glucose tolerance test in pregnancy is not associated with maternal or neonatal adverse outcomes.
birth_weight: Average overall birth weight centiles ranged from 60.1 ± 26.8 to 63 ± 26 across the study groups.
